title: Pokemon TCG Chesnaught V 015/195 Silver Tempest Near Mint
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Chesnaught character in stunning silver rarity. From the Sword & Shield - Silver Tempest set, this card is a must-have for any serious collector or player. With a card number of 015/195, it is a valuable addition to any collection.

Whether you're a fan of the game or a seasoned collector, this card is sure to impress. Add it to your collection today and experience the thrill of owning a rare and coveted Pokémon TCG card.
